title: Fix RealtimeAgent Swarm integration
body:
When running agentchat_realtime_swarm.ipynb example.

After connecting to the client over call, the RealtimeAgent startup fails with `ValueError: Parameter 'func_or_tool' must be a function or a Tool instance, it is '<class 'method'>' instead.`
